title: DataFinder: Scientific Dataset Recommendation from Natural Language Descriptions

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing dataset usage frequencies across different AI communities (NLP, CV, Robotics, ML) to quantify the percentage of papers that converge on a small set of highly popular, status-quo datasets.

Calculating and plotting the distribution of the relative ages of datasets (the number of years between a dataset's publication and a corresponding paper's use of it) to demonstrate a strong researcher preference for recently published datasets.
